messages.author: d4ffc0256db418c1
messages.subject: rstan, Von Mises-Fisher distribution [doubt]
parts:
Hi everyone,

Anyone have idea if the Von Mises-Fisher distribution is expected to be available in the future at rstan?

I saw at the Stan user manual just the Von Mises distribution, which is restricted for only two dimensions. I am developing a AMMI Bayesian model that is a nice model to get insights into Genotype by enviroment interactions of plants under genetic breeding. A restriction of these models is the need to sample orthomal set of vectors, which can be trivially achieved with the Von Mises-Fisher distribution (can be extended beyond two dimentions). 

Thank you!
Best,
Jhonathan Pedroso
Ph.D candidate in Genetics and Plant Breeding at University of São Paulo, Brazil.

messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] rstan, Von Mises-Fisher distribution [doubt]
parts:
Hi Jhonathan,

It looks like the distribution is straightforward to implement in the Stan language for 3 dimensions. There is a section on writing custom distributions in the manual. 

The normalizing constant looks much harder to compute for arbitrary kappas, so I don't think this is something we can tackle in general. If your able to write a custom distribution for 3 dimensions and it works well, we can think about asking the 3 dimensional distribution to the language as a special case. 

Daniel
